_comment: Data ownership registry (DATA-01). Owned by DATA_GOVERNANCE; DATA_LINEAGE generates docs/engineering/DATA_MAP.md from it plus the schema and code (scripts/data-map.mjs); CODE_HYGIENE keeps exportsTriage honest. Every table, view and Storage bucket needs an owner (a registered agent call) and a purpose. Functions inherit the owner of the table they touch most unless listed under functions. UX-14 DATA_GOVERNANCE review: optional originating-client arguments preserve existing exported row/RPC shapes and Storage paths; existing owners remain. Exact outside-session review and map currency are recorded in docs/agents/UX-14.md.
